caveats: Every unit is a bundled programme or unspecified soil and water conservation, so the share due to water harvesting is not isolated; the Karnataka figure comes from a Bank completion report, and the Brazilian statements are a census-based inference without a counterfactual and a statement of potential [ev_soil_water_retention_kar20_2, ev_water_access_deficit_castro22_1, ev_drought_hazard_castro22_2]. Sedimentation is described as perhaps the primary reason for sand dam failure, and tanks desilted in an Indian programme need desilting again within its lifetime [ev_asset_failure_ritc21_3, ev_asset_siltation_verm19_1].
caveats: Severity varies: a Kenyan sand-dam assessment estimates siltation cut storage by 10-25% and judges it neither an inherent limitation nor the main reason dams go unused [ev_asset_siltation_neuf17_1]. Most units are review citations or narrative observations without a common metric, and losses depend on upkeep, as the Moroccan structures failed where no maintenance system had been put in place [ev_asset_siltation_saru19_2, ev_erosion_hazard_iegmar09_2].
